failure_reason: Nested fit-only transport filtering failed at least one frozen gate: 184/321 wins (57.32%), Wilson 51.85%, final-fold WR 48.75%.

identity.candidate_risk_set_policy: within each fold, orient features on the first fit-only subepoch, retain only features with oriented AUC >=0.52 in all four fit-only subepochs, then accept scores above the unchanged causal rolling 99.73rd percentile
identity.execution_policy: paper replay at exact 300 ms entry delay; compound 1.85% of current bankroll; maximum two concurrent positions

material_change_required_before_rerun: A genuinely new causal feature or model family; AUC-floor, subepoch-count, threshold, and model-parameter variants are prohibited.
scientific_basis: A transport diagnostic found a stable causal feature core despite base-rate decay. This experiment nests feature transport selection inside every fit split so calibration and test labels remain unseen.
